spans.quotation: In 2023, we improved on several key safety performance indicators and achieved our safety objectives for the year, including safety goals tied to our annual incentive compensation program. Collectively, we improved on nearly all corporate leading and lagging safety metrics. We surpassed our record-setting safety performance of 2022 — finishing 2023 with an even lower TRIR of 0.22 — and we continued to improve on our Severe Incident Rate (SIR), lowering our overall rate by 55%.

SIR is defined as the rate of incidents resulting in fatal injury, permanent or significant loss or impairment of a body part or organ function, or that otherwise permanently changes or disables individuals in their normal life activity, per 200,000 hours worked. * Apache employees and contractors worked more than 75 million hours in 2023.

note: criteria 1,2,3,4,5 — 5 of 5. Criterion 1 (quantitative): TRIR 0.22 (workforce), SIR 0.005 (workforce), LTIR 0.09 (workforce) for 2023; all disaggregated by employee and contractor; 75 million hours worked; 1 contractor fatality; 0 employee fatalities — all from KPD table (p.129). Criterion 2 (target-bound): SIR target 'at or below 0.028' stated as 2023 compensation-linked goal (p.26, captured in G1 evidence); achieved in 2023 (SIR 0.005 << 0.028); target is named, quantified, and tied to annual incentive compensation. Criterion 3 (methodology): SIR definition stated verbatim on p.83 ('rate of incidents resulting in fatal injury, permanent or significant loss or impairment of a body part or organ function…per 200,000 hours worked'); LTIR calculation basis stated ('total number of lost-time injuries by 200,000 hours, then dividing by total hours worked', per chart footnote p.83); employee vs contractor workforce scope explicitly differentiated in all KPD rows. Criterion 4 (time horizon): 2023 anchor; 5-year longitudinal series 2019–2023 in KPD table; 10-year TRIR chart 2014–2023 on p.82 extends historical window. Criterion 5 (progress tracking): full 5-year series for TRIR, LTIR, SIR, fatalities, and hours worked (2019–2023) in KPD table (p.129); SIR and LTIR charts on p.83 visually confirm multi-year improvement trajectory. Boundary: contractor safety is included within workforce scope (O7); community/indigenous safety belongs to O8 and is not present in selected spans. forward_looking = false: no forward safety targets with target years are disclosed beyond the prior-year incentive goal. assured = false: no named external assurer linked to H&S metrics in selected spans. Cross-concept note: SIR target (≤0.028) also cited in G1 annotation as board-overseen compensation-linked ESG goal; the target content is coded to O7 here and referenced in G1 as evidence of board oversight scope.
